<details>
The PKGBUILD follows standard aur packaging conventions. All top-level code consists of variable assignments (pkgname, pkgver, pkgrel, arch, url, license, depends, makedepends, source, b2sums, etc.) and function definitions (pkgver, prepare, build, package). None of these perform any network requests, file operations, or command substitutions at the top level. The git clone/fetch operations, sed commands, make, and install steps are all encapsulated within function bodies, which are only defined (not executed) when makepkg sources the PKGBUILD.

The `source` array references `$_reponame::git+$url.git` which points to the package's own upstream repository (codeberg.org/schelling/dosbox-pure), but this is just a string assignment -- no fetching or downloading occurs during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. The `b2sums=('SKIP')` value is standard for git/vcs sources and is not executed code. There are no command substitutions, eval calls, base64 decodes, or other forms of obfuscated or malicious code at the global scope. This is a routine -git package for a libretro core.
</details>
